title: Wire incident-aggregation pipeline + report_count column (T4 mitigation)
description:
Threat-model T4 mitigation surface (design.md §9). The threat-model test suite (#39) ships a scoped-down T4 assertion (schema invariants only) because the aggregation pipeline that deduplicates 1M reports into 1 incident is not yet wired.

**Scope.**
1. Add a background aggregator that walks reports WHERE incident_id IS NULL, groups by subject_id within a time window, and updates incident_id on the report rows.
2. Add a report_count column on incidents (or a view) so dashboards do not pay a COUNT(*) on every render.
3. Ensure CSAM-category reports bypass any low-priority-drop heuristic added under load.

**Tests.** The CSAM-priority sub-assertion in tests/threat_t4_dos_report_flood.rs is un-ignored once this lands.
